# peakhour_origin_pool (Resource)

Manages an origin pool for a domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "peakhour_origin_pool" "example" {
  domain = "example.com"
  tag    = "primary"

  address = [{
    address = "origin.example.com:443"
    weight  = 100
  }]

  load_balancing_mode = "round_robin"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (Attributes List) Backend server addresses. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--address))
- `domain` (String) Domain name.
- `tag` (String) Origin pool tag/name.

### Optional

- `load_balancing_key` (String) Load balancing key for consistent hashing.
- `load_balancing_mode` (String) Load balancing mode (e.g., round_robin, least_conn).
- `load_balancing_overload_percent` (Number) Overload percentage for load balancing.
- `shield_name` (String) Shield location name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Origin pool identifier (domain/origins/tag).

<a id="nestedatt--address"></a>
### Nested Schema for `address`

Required:

- `address` (String) Backend address (IP:port, domain:port, or URL).

Optional:

- `weight` (Number) Load balancing weight.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import peakhour_origin_pool.example example.com/origins/primary
```
